author: michaelkrymski
summary: Measure target patch motion and identify bottom-row sector dominance
details: Moving trash can closer changes selected patch median from 1.538 to 1.022 m with all pixels retained. Final right-sector percentile comes from bottom image row; broad near strip across all sectors is consistent with floor but not visually confirmed. Absolute range calibration and original chair cause unresolved. No thresholds, production drift, motors or GitHub changes.
validation: Five independently refreshed snapshots and 40 completed native sends over 8.409852 s; local measurement evidence saved. No new app code or automated tests.
